overview: Based on the published agenda, the Police and Fire Commission of Kronenwetter was scheduled to hold a regular meeting on August 24, 2026, to consider routine business including approval of prior meeting minutes and conduct a closed session interview with Fire Department applicant(s). The meeting was set to address personnel matters related to Fire Department staffing.

agenda.item: Public Comment (15 minutes total, 3 minutes per person)
Closed Session to interview Fire Department applicant(s) pursuant to Wis. Stat. 19.85(1)(f) and 19.85(1)(c)

discussions.body: The commission was scheduled to approve the minutes from its August 10, 2026 meeting.

The commission was set to convene into closed session to interview Fire Department applicant(s) under statutory provisions protecting personnel information and employment matters. The closed session was scheduled to consider employment and performance evaluation data for individuals under the commission's jurisdiction.

publicComment: Public comment was on the agenda, scheduled for up to 15 minutes total with a three-minute time limit per person, subject to extension at the presiding officer's discretion.
actionItems: Scheduled to vote on approval of 08/10/2026 meeting minutes
Scheduled to convene closed session for Fire Department applicant interview(s)
Expected to consider action items following closed session
title: Police and Fire Commission Meeting - 2026-08-24
